# bootpay

**Tag**: web, mobile

## 简介

A Bootpay plugin that provides payment api on Android, iOS and Web.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.bootpay.co.kr
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/bootpay/bootpay_flutter.git
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/bootpay
